text: Diwali night. The whole colony is glowing...
...and the whole colony is standing in one queue.
Did you hear? Crackers are bursting in my tummy!
Evil eye! The bathroom got evil eye!
Tummy is paining... but I'm hungry also!
Who's inside? Hurry up!
Don't take tension!
All this began... three days ago.
With one overly shiny sweet.
Diwali week. The whole colony is dressing up.
Mega Sale! Kaju katli, half price!
Shiny sweets! I'm hungry!
Seth ji, two hundred boxes, half rate, real silver wala, na!
Cheap stock, fat profit!
Seth ji! Real silver at half price?
Bindu, this is Diwali blessing!
I have an idea!
Dadi! Bigger thali than Gupta Aunty... at half price!
This time my thali... the whole colony will see!
Mummyji, half-price kaju katli? Something is fishy.
Not fishy, it's savings!
And then began... the Thali War!
Five boxes! The biggest ones!
Not one rupee less!
Did you hear? Kusum took five boxes!
Six boxes, Seth ji! Six!
Seven!
Don't take tension! Tinku's premium hamper!
Double price, Aunty... double respect!
So many sweets! Evil eye!
The whole colony will see!
I fear nobody! Not even Gupta Aunty!
Real silver at half price? Hmm... I smell something.
Who will teach these grown-ups?
Score? Twelve boxes each. All square!
Laddu, you are the watchman. Not one piece!
Not one piece!
My rangoli is bigger.
My rangoli has more colours.
There will be an inquiry! Into sweet safety!
Sweets?
Inquiry done.
Laddu! Where are the thalis?
That... evil eye!
See! I told you!
Take the hamper! For the whole colony!
Now Seth's sweets... had reached every house.
Hi guys! We're live!
Even leaves aren't this green.
Sweet mukbang! Today's barfi... neon green!
Science says... more colour, more vitamins!
Did you hear, guys? It's healthy!
Green tongue? Science says... it's greenery.
Guys, my tongue turned blue! New filter?
Science says... this is pain.
Two lakh views! Everyone eat blue barfi!
Diwali evening. Kusum Dadi's sweet party!
Come, come! The whole colony will see... and eat!
Kusum ji, why is your katli so shiny?
Real silver! Half-price wala!
Mine too!
Masterji, is this mithai pure?
Parrot green? Yes yes, very beautiful!
Not parrot, Masterji... mithai!
Parrot green, barfi green! Wah!
Science says... shine means freshness!
I fear no sweet!
Thunder? Rain on Diwali!
Did you hear? My tummy is saying something too!
And then... the whole colony's tummy spoke together.
Fourteen people. One bathroom.
I fear nobody... but hurry up!
Seth ji! In the line!
Two rupees... to jump ahead?
Gupta, your tummy... talks more than me.
We're live... from the bathroom queue!
Enough! Now I'll handle it.
One litre boiled cooled water, six spoons sugar...
...half spoon salt. Sip by sip.
Two lemons weren't enough... here's the third!
Just two minutes... don't take tension!
Tinku, your two minutes... are longer than Diwali!
Last one... promise.
Medical shop! Let's go, let's go!
Inquiry will be... on foot.
Everyone's tummy is bad... why are we three fine?
Because we ate laddoos from Pooja Aunty's house!
And here's the proof. Tomorrow morning... science test!
That night, fewer crackers burst... more tummies.
Next morning. Bablu's lab.
Science says... shine means fresh!
My sweet was real!
Mine was more real!
Quiet! Bablu is speaking!
Shall I tell? School test.
Iodine is for wounds. Not for eating!
Blue-black means starch. Maida or arrowroot mixed!
Real khoya has no starch... colour stays brown.
Real silver varq... rub it, turns to powder.
This stuck, kept shining... fake foil!
Science says...
Quiet!
And such a bright colour? Danger bell.
Tested sweets... no eating!
Shabaash Bablu! Tested pieces go in the dustbin.
And I... kept eating, thinking it was a parrot.
Known shop, date and licence on the box.
And I... was just chasing a thali bigger than Gupta's.
Let's go! Seth's shop!
The whole colony marched... to Seth's shop!
Hello! Your real silver... turned out fake!
Arre, which Seth? Wrong number, yaar!
He cheated me too... chasing cheap.
Seth ji! Every box back. Every rupee back.
Bindu... a little less?
Not one rupee less!
Goodbye... my dear coins.
Don't take tension... I'm leaving.
Took double... return double.
Mega sale... mega fail.
This time, the sweets... will be made at home!
Besan, ghee, sugar... that's it! Nothing else.
Kusum ji, my coconut barfi... homemade.
This time one thali... for both of us!
Did you hear? We became friends!
I have an idea! The biggest laddoo!
Quiet! Make it round.
Laddu, from today you are... the Taster!
This job... was made for me!
Quality check... in progress.
And then came... a real, clean, sweet Diwali!
The whole colony will see... one thali!
This time... free!
Seth ji, free? Let's go... to the doctor!
Science says... homemade is the best!
This time I heard right... the sweet is pure!
Dadaji! Today's lesson?
Don't chase cheap... choose clean.
Happy Diwali!
